extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads the current song and sends play, pause and skip to Spotify or Music for its Now Playing pill.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Calendar events in its own calendar. If you turn on writing, it also adds your FocusDesk events and assignments to a calendar called FocusDesk, and changes only that calendar.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Calendar events in its own calendar. If you turn on writing, it also adds your FocusDesk events and assignments to a calendar called FocusDesk, and changes only that calendar.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Reminders in its Tasks. If you turn on writing, it also adds your reminders and tasks to a Reminders list called FocusDesk, and changes only that list.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Reminders in its Tasks. If you turn on writing, it also adds your reminders and tasks to a Reminders list called FocusDesk, and changes only that list.
